consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the band, particularly highlighting the exceptional Scarlet > Fire and Bird Song. Many reviewers note the strong energy and interaction among the band members, making this show a memorable experience.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 42 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm for the performance, especially the standout songs, significantly elevates the sentiment despite some minor criticisms of sound quality.
